items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: It's like you see Ted Williams or Jackie Robinson or Ty Cobb, speaking in baseball like a reference...

ctx.x: Yeah. And it's a happy life you're living. Until you start to get stranded when you get out on the road. Even then, your life isn't (?). They want you to get out, don't hang around. So you see these people, and you look at them, and they're talking about you. It's like you see Ted Williams or Jackie Robinson or Ty Cobb, speaking in baseball like a reference...
